title: TicketQueryResultV1
$comment: Story 3i-2 (AC3) — the stable wire shape for `deliveryline tickets query --format json`. Additive fields are allowed within v1; any removal/rename bumps to v2. shownCount is the number of rows in `tickets`; totalCount is how many tickets matched the filter AT THE SOURCE and may exceed shownCount, because the browse is a bounded page (--limit) and because an individual ticket that cannot be mapped is skipped. truncated is `totalCount > shownCount` — the single flag telling the operator they are not seeing every match. summary is null when the source ticket has no description.
